comment: Written for gEdit (synthetic, not for a machine); see README.md here.
description: Fanuc two-path: in path 1 a GOTO 50 stands alone in an IF[#1EQ1]THEN … ENDIF block (the multi-block IF) and would jump over M902; path 2 has no M902. The jump runs only when #1 is 1, so path 1 may reach M902 and wait there for ever. It is not followed: the missing M902 is reported, before and after.

1: (WRITTEN FOR GEDIT - SYNTHETIC TEST PROGRAM, NOT FOR A MACHINE)
